value.name: Skirk
value.desc: A visitor who once appeared in an Abyssal rift and the Primordial Sea, this solitary warrior mentored Tartaglia in the martial arts.

desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Gains 2</color> <color=#ffffff>Serpent's Subtlety,</color> <color=#ffffffa6>then creates 1</color> <color=#ffffff>Mutual Weapons Mentorship</color> <color=#ffffffa6>and adds it to your Hand. (Once per Round)</color>

<color=#ffd780>Event Card</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>This card attaches</color> <color=#ffffff>Seven-Phase Flash</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to your</color> <color=#ffffff>Skirk</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ffffff>At the start of the Round or after your side performs a switch:</color> <color=#ffffff>Discard</color> <color=#ffffffa6>this card and gain 1</color> <color=#ffffff>Serpent's Subtlety</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Seven-Phase Flash</color>
<color=#ffd780>Status</color>
<color=#ffffff>When the character to which this is attached uses a Normal Attack:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Converts</color> <color=#ffffff>Physical DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>dealt to</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>. If possible, consume up to 2</color> <color=#ffffff>Serpent's Subtlety</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, and for each point consumed, reduce the cost by 1</color> <color=#ffffff>Unaligned Element</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>The character's Elemental Burst changes to</color> <color=#ffffff>Havoc: Extinction</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Duration (Rounds): 1</color>

<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Consumes all</color> <color=#ffffff>Serpent's Subtlety</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, deals</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>equal to the</color> <color=#ffffff>Serpent's Subtlety</color> <color=#ffffffa6>consumed, and deals 2</color> <color=#ffffff>Piercing DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to characters on standby. If 7</color> <color=#ffffff>Serpent's Subtlety</color> <color=#ffffffa6>are consumed, deal 3</color> <color=#ffffff>Piercing DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to characters on standby instead.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Convert 2 non-Omni Elemental Dice into</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo Dice</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color> <color=#ffffff>Discard</color> <color=#ffffffa6>up to 2 cards that originally cost 0 Elemental Dice. For each card</color> <color=#ffffff>Discard</color> <color=#ffffffa6>,</color> <color=#ffffff>Skirk</color> <color=#ffffffa6>gains 1 point of</color> <color=#ffffff>Serpent's Subtlety</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Passive Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(Passive) Skirk is unable to gain Energy but can now accumulate up to 7 points of</color> <color=#ffffff>Serpent's Subtlety</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ffffff>After you trigger Frozen, Cryo Swirl, Superconduct, or Cryo Crystallize reactions:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Create 1</color> <color=#ffffff>Void Rift</color> <color=#ffffffa6>in your hand. (3 times per Round)</color>

<color=#ffd780>Event Card</color>
<color=#ffffff>Combat Action</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: if there is a card with a</color> <color=#ffffff>Current Elemental Dice Cost</color> <color=#ffffffa6>of 3 in your Hand,</color> <color=#ffffff>Discard</color> <color=#ffffffa6>1 card with a</color> <color=#ffffff>Current Elemental Dice Cost</color> <color=#ffffffa6>of 3 from your Hand. Allied</color> <color=#ffffff>Skirk</color> <color=#ffffffa6>then gains 2</color> <color=#ffffff>Serpent's Subtlety</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>

Applies Cryo and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Melt</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Superconduct</color> : DMG+1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Frozen</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, the target is unable to perform any Actions this Round (Can be removed in advance after the target receives Physical or Pyro DMG, in which case they will take +2 DMG)

<color=#ece5d8>Physical DMG</color>
Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.
<color=#ece5d8>Discard</color>
Use Action Cards or Character Skill effects to Discard Action Cards from Hand or Deck.
<color=#ece5d8>Piercing DMG</color>
Piercing DMG cannot be increased by any bonuses, but cannot be defended against using Shields or DMG Immunity either.
<color=#ece5d8>Unaligned Element</color>
You may use Elemental Dice of any element to pay this type of cost.
<color=#ece5d8>Duration (Rounds)</color>
Each time you reach the end of a Round, <color=#ffffff>Duration (Rounds)</color> -1.
This card will be discarded immediately once <color=#ffffff>Duration (Rounds)</color> runs out.
<color=#ebe4d8>Combat Action</color>
After you finish 1 Combat Action, it will be your opponent's turn.
<color=#ffffff>Playing a card from your Hand with this rule is also a Combat Action rather than a Fast Action</color> .
<color=#ebe4d8>Current Elemental Dice Cost</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>If a</color> <color=#ffffff>Cost Increase</color> <color=#ffffffa6>or</color> <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> <color=#ffffffa6>is attached to an Action Card, its current Elemental Dice cost will be adjusted accordingly.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(Effects that reduce the Elemental Dice cost when playing the card do not affect this cost.)</color>
<color=#ebe4d8>Cost Increase</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Every stack makes playing this card cost 1 additional Elemental Die. (Can stack, no stack limit)</color>
<color=#ebe4d8>Cost Reduction</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Every stack makes playing this card cost 1 fewer Elemental Die. (Can stack, no stack limit)</color>
